title: Chunking verdicts under count- and budget-matched retrieval: code, analysis plans and results
description:
Code, written analysis plans (pre-registration documents), deviation logs, run manifests and per-query results for a multiverse analysis of how the retrieval-selection protocol (a fixed number of chunks vs a fixed word budget) changes chunking verdicts in retrieval-augmented generation. Includes an extension to semantic chunking and dense retrieval (bge-m3), an exploratory answer-quality check (Qwen3-4B) and a provisional, single-coded protocol audit of recent chunking studies. The original version history is unavailable, so the timing of the analysis plans cannot be independently verified.

Code is MIT-licensed; project-written results, documents and figures are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md). The four source datasets are not redistributed; they are downloaded and hash-checked by the included fetch script. Gold answer strings and model answers stored in the generation logs remain under the source datasets' licences (SQuAD 2.0 CC BY-SA 4.0, COVID-QA Apache-2.0, CUAD and Qasper CC BY 4.0).
